MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Antarctic Whaling Flag.
1. Reference memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file No. AG 800.217 (6 Aug 46)NR, (SCAPIN 1103), 6 August 1946, subject: Japanese Whaling Operations in the Antarctic.
2. Paragraph 4 b of reference memorandum is amended to read, "Each vessel will display in the usual manner the flag of the Japanese Merchant Marine plus the modified international code flag 'E.'"
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
